prompt: Analyze frequently purchased product combinations to identify common bundles in the sales data. Compare how these co-purchase patterns differ across store locations and seasonal time periods.
title: Co-Purchase Bundle Analysis
summary: Analyze frequently purchased product combinations to identify common bundles in the sales data. Compare co-purchase patterns across store locations and seasonal time periods to highlight location- and season-specific buying behavior.
executed_sql_queries:
WITH store_bounds AS (
  SELECT MIN(store_id) AS min_store_id, MAX(store_id) AS max_store_id
  FROM retail.stores
), target_stores AS (
  SELECT store_id
  FROM retail.stores s
  CROSS JOIN store_bounds b
  WHERE s.store_id <= FLOOR((b.min_store_id + b.max_store_id) / 2.0)
), filtered_orders AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.store_id, o.order_date
  FROM retail.orders o
  JOIN target_stores t ON o.store_id = t.store_id
), filtered_items AS (
  SELECT oi.order_item_id, oi.order_id, oi.store_id, oi.product_id, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price, oi.discount_percent, oi.discount_amount, oi.total_amount
  FROM retail.order_items oi
  JOIN target_stores t ON oi.store_id = t.store_id
)
SELECT 
  fo.order_id,
  fo.customer_id,
  fo.store_id,
  fo.order_date,
  fi.order_item_id,
  fi.product_id,
  p.product_name,
  p.category_id,
  p.type_id,
  fi.quantity AS order_quantity,
  fi.unit_price,
  fi.discount_percent,
  fi.discount_amount,
  fi.total_amount,
  COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY fo.order_id) AS line_item_count
FROM filtered_orders fo
JOIN filtered_items fi ON fo.order_id = fi.order_id
JOIN retail.products p ON fi.product_id = p.product_id
ORDER BY fo.order_id, fi.order_item_id
LIMIT 500

SELECT store_id, store_name, CASE WHEN is_online THEN 'Online' ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(store_name, '^Zava Retail ', '') END AS store_location FROM retail.stores WHERE CASE WHEN is_online THEN 'Online' ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(store_name, '^Zava Retail ', '') END IN ('Seattle','Bellevue','Tacoma','Spokane','Everett','Redmond','Kirkland','Online') ORDER BY CASE WHEN is_online THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, store_location

WITH order_season AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.order_date,
    CASE
      WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) IN (12,1,2) THEN 'Winter'
      WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) IN (3,4,5) THEN 'Spring'
      WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) IN (6,7,8) THEN 'Summer'
      ELSE 'Fall'
    END AS season
  FROM retail.orders o
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2026
), pair_orders AS (
  SELECT
    os.season,
    a.order_id,
    a.product_id AS product_id_1,
    b.product_id AS product_id_2,
    SUM(a.quantity) AS quantity_1,
    SUM(b.quantity) AS quantity_2,
    SUM(a.total_amount + b.total_amount) AS pair_sales_amount
  FROM order_season os
  JOIN retail.order_items a ON os.order_id = a.order_id
  JOIN retail.order_items b ON os.order_id = b.order_id AND a.product_id < b.product_id
  GROUP BY os.season, a.order_id, a.product_id, b.product_id
), pair_agg AS (
  SELECT
    season,
    product_id_1,
    product_id_2,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS bundle_order_count,
    SUM(quantity_1) AS total_quantity_1,
    SUM(quantity_2) AS total_quantity_2,
    SUM(pair_sales_amount) AS total_pair_sales_amount
  FROM pair_orders
  GROUP BY season, product_id_1, product_id_2
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    pa.*,
    p1.product_name AS product_name_1,
    p1.category_id AS category_id_1,
    p1.type_id AS type_id_1,
    p2.product_name AS product_name_2,
    p2.category_id AS category_id_2,
    p2.type_id AS type_id_2,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa.season ORDER BY pa.bundle_order_count DESC, pa.total_pair_sales_amount DESC) AS rn
  FROM pair_agg pa
  JOIN retail.products p1 ON pa.product_id_1 = p1.product_id
  JOIN retail.products p2 ON pa.product_id_2 = p2.product_id
)
SELECT
  season,
  product_id_1,
  product_name_1,
  category_id_1,
  type_id_1,
  product_id_2,
  product_name_2,
  category_id_2,
  type_id_2,
  bundle_order_count,
  total_quantity_1,
  total_quantity_2,
  total_pair_sales_amount
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 10
ORDER BY season, bundle_order_count DESC, total_pair_sales_amount DESC;

WITH order_years AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int AS order_year
  FROM retail.orders o
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
), pair_lines AS (
  SELECT
    oy.order_year,
    LEAST(oi1.product_id, oi2.product_id) AS product_id_1,
    GREATEST(oi1.product_id, oi2.product_id) AS product_id_2,
    SUM(oi1.quantity + oi2.quantity) AS total_quantities,
    SUM(oi1.total_amount + oi2.total_amount) AS total_revenues,
    COUNT(DISTINCT oy.order_id) AS bundle_order_count
  FROM order_years oy
  JOIN retail.order_items oi1 ON oy.order_id = oi1.order_id
  JOIN retail.order_items oi2 ON oy.order_id = oi2.order_id AND oi1.product_id < oi2.product_id
  GROUP BY oy.order_year, LEAST(oi1.product_id, oi2.product_id), GREATEST(oi1.product_id, oi2.product_id)
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    pl.order_year,
    p1.product_name AS product_name_1,
    p2.product_name AS product_name_2,
    pl.bundle_order_count,
    pl.total_quantities,
    pl.total_revenues,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pl.order_year ORDER BY pl.total_revenues DESC, pl.bundle_order_count DESC, p1.product_name, p2.product_name) AS rn
  FROM pair_lines pl
  JOIN retail.products p1 ON pl.product_id_1 = p1.product_id
  JOIN retail.products p2 ON pl.product_id_2 = p2.product_id
)
SELECT order_year, product_name_1, product_name_2, bundle_order_count, total_quantities, total_revenues
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 10
ORDER BY order_year, total_revenues DESC, bundle_order_count DESC, product_name_1, product_name_2;

WITH order_pair_lines AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) IN (2020, 2021) THEN '2020-2021'
      WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) IN (2022, 2023) THEN '2022-2023'
    END AS year_slice,
    o.order_id,
    LEAST(a.product_id, b.product_id) AS product_id_1,
    GREATEST(a.product_id, b.product_id) AS product_id_2,
    (a.quantity + b.quantity) AS pair_quantity,
    (a.total_amount + b.total_amount) AS pair_revenue
  FROM retail.orders o
  JOIN retail.order_items a
    ON o.order_id = a.order_id
  JOIN retail.order_items b
    ON o.order_id = b.order_id
   AND a.product_id < b.product_id
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) IN (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023)
), pair_rollup AS (
  SELECT
    year_slice,
    product_id_1,
    product_id_2,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS pair_count,
    SUM(pair_quantity) AS total_pair_quantity,
    SUM(pair_revenue) AS total_pair_revenue
  FROM order_pair_lines
  GROUP BY year_slice, product_id_1, product_id_2
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    pr.year_slice,
    p1.product_name AS product_name_1,
    p2.product_name AS product_name_2,
    pr.product_id_1,
    pr.product_id_2,
    pr.pair_count,
    pr.total_pair_quantity,
    pr.total_pair_revenue,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY pr.year_slice
      ORDER BY pr.pair_count DESC, pr.total_pair_revenue DESC, pr.product_id_1, pr.product_id_2
    ) AS rn
  FROM pair_rollup pr
  JOIN retail.products p1 ON pr.product_id_1 = p1.product_id
  JOIN retail.products p2 ON pr.product_id_2 = p2.product_id
)
SELECT
  year_slice,
  product_id_1,
  product_name_1,
  product_id_2,
  product_name_2,
  pair_count,
  total_pair_quantity,
  total_pair_revenue
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 10
ORDER BY year_slice, rn;

WITH order_years AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int AS order_year
  FROM retail.orders o
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT
    oy.order_year,
    LEAST(oi1.product_id, oi2.product_id) AS product_id_1,
    GREATEST(oi1.product_id, oi2.product_id) AS product_id_2,
    COUNT(*) AS pair_line_count,
    SUM(oi1.quantity + oi2.quantity) AS pair_quantity,
    SUM(oi1.total_amount + oi2.total_amount) AS pair_revenue
  FROM order_years oy
  JOIN retail.order_items oi1 ON oy.order_id = oi1.order_id
  JOIN retail.order_items oi2 ON oy.order_id = oi2.order_id AND oi1.product_id < oi2.product_id
  GROUP BY oy.order_year, LEAST(oi1.product_id, oi2.product_id), GREATEST(oi1.product_id, oi2.product_id)
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    p.order_year,
    p.product_id_1,
    p.product_id_2,
    p.pair_line_count,
    p.pair_quantity,
    p.pair_revenue,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.order_year ORDER BY p.pair_line_count DESC, p.pair_revenue DESC) AS rn
  FROM pairs p
)
SELECT
  r.order_year,
  p1.product_name AS product_name_1,
  p2.product_name AS product_name_2,
  r.pair_line_count AS bundle_count,
  r.pair_quantity,
  r.pair_revenue
FROM ranked r
JOIN retail.products p1 ON r.product_id_1 = p1.product_id
JOIN retail.products p2 ON r.product_id_2 = p2.product_id
WHERE r.rn <= 10
ORDER BY r.order_year, r.pair_line_count DESC, r.pair_revenue DESC;
